screen.surfaceparticles.config.title: Surface Particles Config
config.surfaceparticles.enable_sprint_pa: Sprint particles come from the surface you actually run on (snow layers, carpets) and use its top texture with the biome tint
config.surfaceparticles.enable_hit_parti: Crack particles while mining use the texture of the face being hit
config.surfaceparticles.enable_destroy_p: The break cloud is textured per face: outer particles take the face they sit on, inner ones keep the vanilla look
